Build me a Egyptian temple ruin isolated in a vast, softly rolling orange desert. Place one compact rectangular temple as the dominant structure, its massive pale sandstone walls slightly battered and articulated with shallow projecting sections, engraved panels, faded figures and hieroglyphic bands, thin gold accents, and turquoise, yellow, red, and blue painted friezes. Give it a flat, nearly complete slab roof enclosed by an uneven pale stone coping. Orient the decorated entrance toward an open forecourt: the façade should have a broad shadowed central opening, several closely spaced papyrus-style columns with colorful flared capitals, shorter square supports, and low painted railings, revealing a dark columned interior and a faintly illuminated passage beyond. Keep the other three elevations mostly solid and monumental, with repeated rectangular relief panels and horizontal ornamental courses. In front and slightly to one side, arrange the remains of a detached colonnade: four tall, slender painted columns set in a loose line beneath two incomplete, offset sandstone lintel beams, leaving obvious gaps and broken continuity. Scatter an irregular trail of cracked paving slabs and small fragments around their bases, partly swallowed by sand.

Give it a flat, nearly complete slab roof enclosed by an uneven pale stone coping. Orient the decorated entrance toward an open forecourt: the façade should have a broad shadowed central opening, several closely spaced papyrus-style columns with colorful flared capitals, shorter square supports, and low painted railings, revealing a dark columned interior and a faintly illuminated passage beyond. Keep the other three elevations mostly solid and monumental, with repeated rectangular relief panels and horizontal ornamental courses. In front and slightly to one side, arrange the remains of a detached colonnade: four tall, slender painted columns set in a loose line beneath two incomplete, offset sandstone lintel beams, leaving obvious gaps and broken continuity. Scatter an irregular trail of cracked paving slabs and small fragments around their bases, partly swallowed by sand.

    over empty space -- which is a failed reconstruction no matter how good
    the massing is. These palette entries are also flat surfaces you can tile
    by hand if you prefer:
